faqs.q: Who can apply for Diaspora Health Insurance?
faqs.a: Any Kenyan living abroad can purchase a policy for their family members residing in Kenya.

faqs.q: What documents are required to apply for Diaspora Health Insurance?
faqs.a: You will need a copy of your national ID or passport and the details of the family members you want to cover.

faqs.q: Can I pay in instalments?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer flexible payment options, including instalments, to make it convenient for you.

faqs.q: How can my family members access healthcare services?
faqs.a: Once covered, your family can visit any of our 500+ accredited hospitals and clinics across Kenya—including rural areas—using their Jubilee Health Insurance card or digital confirmation.

faqs.q: What happens if I miss a payment?
faqs.a: You have a 30-day grace period before the policy is suspended. You can reactivate the policy by clearing any outstanding payments within this period.

faqs.q: How do I track my family’s insurance usage?
faqs.a: We are developing a customer portal where you can check claim history and monitor usage from abroad.

faqs.q: Can my family use this cover in rural areas?
faqs.a: Yes! Jubilee Health Insurance has a comprehensive network of accredited hospitals and clinics, including rural areas.

faqs.q: How quickly does coverage begin after payment?
faqs.a: Coverage begins immediately once your payment is confirmed, and you will receive a policy document and confirmation.

faqs.q: Can I cover more than one family member?
faqs.a: Yes, you can cover multiple family members under one policy. Just provide their details during the application process.

faqs.q: How do I get assistance if I have more questions?
faqs.a: You can reach us via WhatsApp, call our support line at +254 709 949 000, or email health@jubileekenya.com.
